programs.title: Tales in the Fields Ep.2
programs.desc: From field archaeology and wetland species to urban ecology and ice fishing, this documentary offers exclusive footage, mostly filmed for the first time. With scientific guidance from the Chinese Academy of Sciences, it uncovers hidden mysteries of nature and humanity alike.

programs.title: Hidden Creatures of China Ep.1
programs.desc: Rooted in scientific exploration, this documentary blends natural ecology with the human spirit, vividly illustrating the value of biodiversity. It also serves as a reflection of China Media Group's creative vision: \"Let science, literature, spirit, and nature illuminate one another.\.
